name: Craftsman's Writ: Gnomish Universal Remote
statusNote: New in Forever. Its level is not known yet. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Gnomish Universal Remote, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Seems we are in luck, the remote has arrived! Looks like you precalibrated it for us which, I'll admit, isn't ideal for this scenario. I should be able to reverse engineer it in no time. Then maybe, hopefully, I'll be able to take a much needed break. Feels like I've been stuck fumbling with this teleporter's controls for months on end!
narrative.requestItemsText: Careful where you walk, Gizmo! This thing likes to activate when you least expect it, and we don't quite have a handle on where it can take you when we aren't actively manning the controls.

mentionedItems.name: Gnomish Universal Remote
tooltip: Use: Allows control of a mechanical target for a short time. It may not always work and may just root the machine or make it very very angry. Gnomish engineering at its finest. (3 Min Cooldown)
